data.body_html:
Planning a marbella yacht charter weather may 2032 trip? This guide gives you the numbers you need: temperatures, wind, sea conditions, and booking tips. All our charters depart from Puerto Banús, with a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT included. No fluff—just data to help you decide.

Average Temperatures in May 2032

Daytime highs in Marbella during May 2032 average 22°C, with overnight lows around 17°C. Sea surface temperature reaches 18°C by mid-month, pleasant for swimming. The coastal microclimate, sheltered by La Concha mountain, keeps humidity low. May avoids the peak heat of July (30°C+) while offering 10 hours of sunshine daily—ideal for cruising the Costa del Sol.

Wind and Sea Conditions

Prevailing winds are easterly (Levante) at 10–15 knots, occasionally gusting to 20. Mornings are calmest; afternoon breezes pick up. Sea state is typically slight to moderate (1–2 m swell). From Puerto Banús, you can head west to Estepona or east to Cabopino, choosing sheltered coves like Cala del Faro. Our fleet—from the Azimut 39 (11 pax) to the Mangusta 80 (12 pax, includes jet ski)—handles these conditions with ease.

Sunshine and Rainfall

May 2032 offers 10 hours of daylight, with sunrise around 07:15 and sunset at 21:15. Rain is rare: historically 2–3 days with total precipitation ~20 mm. UV index is high (7–8), so bring SPF 30+. We monitor forecasts and can reschedule if needed—though May is one of the most reliable months for fair weather.

Best Routes and Destinations

With mild winds and warm sun, May is perfect for a sunset cruise along the Golden Mile or a day trip to Sotogrande. Popular stops include Cala Cortés for swimming and Puerto Banús for lunch. For longer charters (8 hours), head east to Cabopino or west to Estepona. Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours, ideal for short escapes.

Booking Tips for May 2032

May is shoulder season: fewer crowds than summer, but weekends book fast. For the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (Tier A: €749/2h to €2,299/8h), book by March. For the Mangusta 80 (Tier B: €4,719/4h, includes jet ski), confirm availability early. Larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Canados 86 are priced on request via WhatsApp. All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance.

What to Bring and Wear

Pack light layers: T-shirt, shorts, a windproof jacket. Evenings cool to 17°C, so bring a jumper. Sunscreen, hat, and sunglasses are essential. We provide soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. No need to bring towels or safety gear—we cover everything.
